about.title: Who We Are
about.heading: Where Quality Meets Convenience
about.description: Carzio is a trusted car hire company based in Agadir, Morocco, dedicated to providing reliable and affordable vehicle rental services. Whether you're exploring the city, embarking on a coastal adventure, or traveling for business — we've got you covered.
about.highlight1Desc: From compact city cars to luxury SUVs, our fleet covers every need with modern, well-maintained vehicles.
about.highlight2Desc: Competitive pricing with no hidden fees. Get the best value for your money with transparent, upfront costs.
about.highlight3Desc: Seamless travel experience with convenient pickup and drop-off directly at Agadir Al Massira Airport.
about.highlight4Desc: Our dedicated team is available 24/7 to assist you with any questions or concerns during your rental.

termsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.intro: By accessing the carzio website, you fully accept these Terms and Conditions.
termsPage.section1Content: Website: refers to the carzio website. User: any person browsing the website or using our services. Provider: carzio, the car rental service provider.
termsPage.section2Content: carzio provides car rental services. Details regarding available vehicles, prices, and specific conditions are available on the website.
termsPage.section3Content: Access to the website is free, while rental services are paid. The User is responsible for their own equipment and internet connection.
termsPage.section4Content: Provide accurate information when making a booking. Comply with the specific rental conditions for each vehicle. Not use the website for illegal purposes.
termsPage.section5Content: Bookings are made through our secure online platform. Payment is made upon vehicle delivery. A confirmation will be sent after booking. Prices are displayed in euros. Important: Upon delivery, the total amount must be paid in cash, either in euros or Moroccan dirhams, when receiving the vehicle.
termsPage.section6Content: Cancellation conditions may vary depending on the booking. Please refer to our Refund Policy for more details.
termsPage.section7Content: carzio is committed to providing high-quality services but shall not be held responsible for: Misuse of the vehicle. Errors resulting from incorrect information provided by the User.
termsPage.section8Content: We collect and process your data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Your information will never be shared without your consent.
termsPage.section9Content: All website content (texts, images, logos) is the property of carzio. Any reproduction or reuse without prior authorization is prohibited.
termsPage.section10Content: These Terms are governed by Moroccan law. Any disputes shall fall under the jurisdiction of the courts of Agadir.
termsPage.section11Content: carzio reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. Changes will take effect immediately upon publication on the website.
termsPage.section12Content: In the event of a lost car key, a fee of €150 will be charged. In the event of lost vehicle documents, a fee of €500 will be charged.
termsPage.section13Content: All vehicle reservations submitted through the website are considered availability requests and are not automatically confirmed. The agency reserves the right to review each request and confirm availability before final approval. Customers are required to provide accurate booking information, including their full name, age, email address, phone number, and pickup details. A transportation/delivery fee may apply depending on the selected pickup location: Casablanca Mohammed V International Airport: Additional €80 transportation fee. Marrakech Airport - Al Manara: Additional €80 transportation fee. Agadir Airport - Al Massira: Free transportation. Essaouira Airport - Mogador: Free transportation. Taghazout: Free transportation. Tamraght: Free transportation.
termsPage.section14Content: No security deposit, caution, or guarantee amount shall be required from the customer at the time of booking or vehicle reservation. The customer shall not be obligated to pay, block, or hold any deposit or security amount in connection with the booking of a vehicle, except where expressly stated otherwise in writing by the agency.
